chapter: Building the band, Ivie Anderson and touring
title: Second session; Snowden and the early Kentucky Club personnel
summary: Crouch resumes on January 12, 1979 and asks about Elmer Snowden and the line-up.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: January 12, 1979. Sonny's home, 400 Central Park West. Part II.
When you got to New York, you all four in the band, and Elmer Snowden was in the band, was he not.
And when did he leave. the band?
Exactly -- he stayed with us, a couple of years. He stayed with us at the Kentucky Club a couple of years.
Let me see. Then like at that time when Elmer Snowden was in the band, who was the personnel of the band then.
Was Snowden, Hardwicke, Charlie Irvis and Whetsol, Arthur Whetsol.
